verdict.rationale: Jira's own docs say Rovo AI can break down work and automatically assign tasks to the right person, which is a core triage step. They also say Rovo AI can build custom automation rules that move work forward. Nothing shows AI assessing incoming bugs to set priority or severity; the 'prioritize high-impact work' claim is not tied to AI. Missing for 10: AI-driven prioritization or severity setting for incoming issues, explicit triage of newly submitted bugs, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
